description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Chemical Reaction Engineering topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: chemical-reaction-engineering

facts.claim: Rate increases with reactant concentration (rate law)

source.quote: Reaction rate increases with concentration, as described by the rate law and explained by collision theory

facts.claim: Temperature, catalyst and other effects go into the rate constant

source.quote: are taken into account in the reaction rate coefficient

facts.claim: k = A e^(−Ea/RT): temperature dependence of rate

source.quote: the Arrhenius equation is a formula for the temperature dependence of reaction rates
Ea is the molar activation energy for the reaction

facts.claim: An elementary reaction occurs in a single step

source.quote: react directly to form products in a single reaction step and with a single transition state

facts.claim: In a batch reactor nothing flows in or out during reaction

source.quote: the reactants, products and solvent do not flow in or out of the vessel during

facts.claim: An ideal CSTR is perfectly mixed: outlet = tank contents

source.quote: The behavior of a CSTR is often approximated or modeled by that of an ideal CSTR, which assumes perfect mixing

facts.claim: PFR: plugs move axially, mixed radially but not axially

source.quote: the fluid is perfectly mixed in the radial direction but not in the axial direction

facts.claim: Many CSTRs in series approach a PFR

source.quote: an infinite number of infinitely small CSTRs operating in series would be equivalent to a PFR
"yield", "conversion" and "selectivity" are terms used to describe ratios

facts.claim: RTD: distribution of times fluid elements spend in the reactor

source.quote: which is known as residence time distribution (RTD)

facts.claim: Heterogeneous catalysts are in a different phase (often solid with gas reactants)

source.quote: Heterogeneous catalysis is catalysis where the phase of catalysts differs from that of the reagents or products
the catalyst is the adsorbent and the reactants are the adsorbate

facts.claim: Langmuir isotherm gives surface coverage; LH mechanism for surface reactions

source.quote: The last expression is the Langmuir isotherm for the surface coverage

facts.claim: Thiele modulus compares reaction rate with pore diffusion

source.quote: The Thiele Modulus was developed to describe the relationship between diffusion and reaction rates in porous catalyst pellets

facts.claim: Rate depends on reactant state, concentration, temperature (and catalysts)

source.quote: The main factors that influence the reaction rate include: the physical state of the reactants, the concentrations of the reactants, the temperature
